description: GPS-Ortung24 connects your AI assistant to your vehicle fleet. Ask in plain language where a vehicle is, which vehicles are moving or parked, how far they drove, whether there were any alerts, or generate a GoBD-compliant logbook for last month — and get an instant answer including plain-text addresses. Access is strictly read-only and multi-tenant: each customer signs in with their own GPS-Ortung24 account via OAuth and sees only their own vehicles. Drivers are pseudonymized; billing data is never exposed.
